jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities
	
• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.	
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.	
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.	
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.	
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Your daily tasks will include:

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance

• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge

Jobomschrijving

You lead individual donor retention strategy to maximise donor lifetime value and drive sustainable fundraising growth through data-driven donor journeys, strong donor loyalty, and an outstanding donor experience.

Your role ?

jobs.occupation: E-commerce & Digital Experience Specialist - Retail sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing European player in the health, wellness and retail sector, with a strong presence across Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain.

Founded in 2014, the Group has developed a successful omnichannel business model, combining an extensive network of physical stores with high-performing e-commerce platforms. With more than 200 points of sale and over 2,000 employees, the company is continuing its international growth, driven by innovation, operational excellence and a strong commitment to customer experience.

Joining this organisation means becoming part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial international group where digital transformation and customer-centricity are at the heart of the growth strategy.

Jobomschrijving

As E-commerce & Digital Experience Specialist , you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the company e-commerce platforms.

Working at the crossroads of e-commerce, digital performance, IT and customer experience, you will monitor platform performance, coordinate incidents, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to the implementation of new digital functionalities.

Your excellent command of Dutch will be particularly important in ensuring the quality and consistency of the Belgian Dutch-language webshop, from content and translations to the overall customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor the daily performance and operational KPIs of the Benelux e-commerce platforms, ensuring a smooth and reliable online customer experience.
• Oversee payment and delivery processes and proactively identify potential issues impacting customer satisfaction or conversion.
• Coordinate incidents with internal stakeholders across E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics and Project teams, as well as external partners.
• Investigate root causes, recommend corrective actions and drive continuous improvements across processes and tools.
• Take ownership of the quality of the Dutch-language Belgian webshop, reviewing content, translations and the end-to-end customer journey.
• Analyse digital performance, user behaviour and customer data to identify opportunities to improve conversion, usability and overall experience.
• Set up, monitor and analyse A/B tests and translate insights into concrete optimisation initiatives.
• Contribute to the delivery of new digital functionalities, from gathering business requirements and functional analysis through testing and release validation.
• Manage and prioritise the e-commerce backlog in close collaboration with Group Project and IT teams.
• Support the implementation of new marketing, personalisation and digital optimisation tools.
• Collaborate with Benelux and Group teams to share best practices and contribute to the broader international digital roadmap.

• Native or near-native Dutch speaker, with an excellent understanding of the Dutch language and strong attention to linguistic and content quality.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in E-Business, Digital Marketing, Business IT or a related field.
• At least 4 years of experience in e-commerce, digital operations, web operations or a comparable role.
• Strong understanding of e-commerce operations, digital performance and customer journey optimisation.
• Experience in an omnichannel, retail or international environment is highly valued.
• Good command of French and professional proficiency in English.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and insights into actionable improvements.
• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Comfortable working across business and technical teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
• Experience with tools such as Google Analytics 4, Contentsquare, Heap, Kameleoon, JIRA or similar platforms is a strong advantage.
• Knowledge of e-commerce CMS platforms such as Hybris, as well as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Google Tag Manager, is a plus.
• Curious, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a genuine interest in digital innovation.

• Leading international consulting organization supporting large-scale business and digital transformation programs across multiple industries.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead workshops to gather, challenge, and translate business requirements into S2P solutions.
• Configure and implement Ivalua solutions aligned with client procurement and finance processes.
• Coordinate and align stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, and IT functions.

An international technology company operating in the media sector is looking for an Information Security Engineer to join the IT Security team within the corporate IT department. The role focuses on operational cybersecurity activities, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response support, security assessments, and continuous improvement of security controls.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, operational follow-up, coordination, and continuous improvement. The position is part of a structured cybersecurity and compliance programme in the context of NIS2 obligations under Belgian law and the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a target of April 2027. The consultant/employee will contribute directly to control implementation, evidence production, and audit readiness across the corporate IT perimeter.

Practical information

 
• Location: Seraing (Liège), Belgium
 
• Contract type: open to freelance consultant or permanent employee, depending on profile
 
• Start date: as soon as possible
 
• Remote work: hybrid model with 2 days per week remote and 3 days on site
 
• Travel: no travel required
 
• Reporting line: Cybersec Operations Manager
 
• Working language: French for day-to-day team interactions, with professional English required for documentation, tools, and international stakeholders
 
• Team context: the IT Security team is being structured and scaled, in a build environment rather than a steady-state operation

Main responsibilities

Security operations & monitoring:

 
• Monitor and investigate security alerts across multiple security platforms
 
• Participate in incident response activities and support the coordination of security investigations
 
• Improve and tune detection capabilities and monitoring use cases
 
• Support the development and maintenance of operational security procedures and playbooks
 
• Perform operational security reviews and follow-up activities

Vulnerability & exposure management:

 
• Coordinate vulnerability scanning activities and ensure findings are reviewed and prioritized
 
• Follow up remediation actions with infrastructure, platform, application, and support teams
 
• Track remediation progress and escalate overdue actions when required
 
• Coordinate external penetration tests and security assessments
 
• Ensure findings from assessments and pentests are documented, tracked, and remediated

Security assessments & risk management:

 
• Perform security reviews of applications, services, and technical solutions
 
• Contribute to risk assessments for new projects, technologies, and providers
 
• Review security configurations and identify improvement opportunities
 
• Support the identification and management of security risks across the IT environment

Security governance & reporting:

 
• Maintain and monitor operational security KPIs and dashboards
 
• Support reporting related to vulnerabilities, incidents, security posture, and remediation efforts
 
• Participate in periodic reviews of user access, privileged accounts, and security controls
 
• Contribute to compliance activities and implementation of security requirements related to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIS2
 
• Produce and maintain auditable evidence of security control operations, including logs, reports, review records, and remediation closure evidence

Security improvement & automation:

 
• Identify opportunities to improve security controls and operational processes
 
• Contribute to...
...

Experience:

• Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, or a related technical security role

• Experience in security monitoring, incident handling, or vulnerability management

• Experience working with security tools and operational security processes

 

Technical knowledge:

• Understanding of security monitoring and incident response principles

• Knowledge of vulnerability management processes and risk-based remediation prioritization, including CVSS scores, asset criticality, exploitability context, and compensating controls

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for EndPoint, Defender for Office 365 / Exchange Online Protection, and Defender for Identity

• Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel or an equivalent SIEM platform; deployment experience is a strong asset

• Understanding of Entra ID governance, including Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

• Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Purview

• Understanding of network security fundamentals, including Firewall management with Palo Alto or FortiGate, log forwarding, and network segmentation principles

• Familiarity with security frameworks and best practices such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls

 

Personal skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

• Organized, structured, and detail-oriented

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams

• Curious, proactive, and willing to continuously learn new technologies and security trends

• Strong communication and coordination skills

• Practical and solution-oriented team player

 

Languages:

• Fluent French

• Professional English required

 

Nice to have certifications

• SC-200 — Microsoft Security Operations Analyst

• SC-300 — Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
